Chapter 474: Chapter 14 The Long Three Hundred Years 2 (The title of the previous chapter was wrong, but the content is unaffected)_2

“`

Normal Eighth Layer Evolvers, even the most talented and exceptional, can at most master one type of Cosmic Force, or at most, two. As for more?

That has never happened before.

Because it’s unrealistic.

“Comprehending a certain Power of Creation is very difficult for other Immortal Kings, they would rather deepen their understanding of the Power of Creation they have already mastered with the time they have, but I have Against-Heaven’s Understanding, it’s just a matter of time…..”

Lin Yuan had a smile on his face.

...

He had already imagined the scenario. By the time he returned to the Main World, mastering dozens of Cosmic Forces and adding the amplification from his vast Inner World that far surpassed the constraints of human Evolvers,

he might even have the chance to arm-wrestle with Ninth Rank powerhouses.

Throughout history, even the most invincible Eighth Layer beings could at most preserve their lives against Ninth Rank powerhouses, let alone arm-wrestle?

That was seeking death.

Because the way an invincible Eighth Layer being preserved their life in front of a Ninth Rank powerhouse was to hang on without dying for a while and then wait for rescue from a Ninth Layer powerhouse of the same race.

Under normal circumstances, Eighth Layer invincibles had no capacity to resist against those of the Ninth Layer.

“First, I need to fully comprehend this wisp of Innate Purple Qi…” Lin Yuan collected his thoughts and began to observe the wisp of purple qi before him seriously.

[Your understanding is Against-Heaven’s, you gaze upon the mysterious breath, beginning to attempt full comprehension…]

…

[Your understanding is Against-Heaven’s, you gaze upon the mysterious breath, beginning to attempt full comprehension…]

…

[Your understanding is Against-Heaven’s, you gaze upon the mysterious breath, beginning to attempt full comprehension…]

…

According to Lin Yuan’s perception of the Innate Purple Qi, this Cosmic Force was just an ordinary one, incomparable to higher Cosmic Forces.

The Taiji force he controlled should be considered a higher Cosmic Force, simultaneously accommodating two extreme rules, whether for attack or defense, it’s nearly perfect.

…

Xianyao City.

As a common city within the Xuanwang Domain, recently a large number of True Immortal-level Powerhouses, and even Half-Step Immortal King-level Powerhouses, have come, eager to see the Martial Ancestor in person.

Whenever there is a trace of a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King, it draws numerous powerful individuals. Whether they can meet the Immortal King or not, it’s worth approaching first.

Many pinnacle True Immortals and Half-Step Immortal King-level Powerhouses have been stuck at their current bottleneck for tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of years; seclusion doesn’t hold much significance.

Instead of wandering aimlessly, it’s better to seek out the traces of Immortal Kings.

There’s nothing to lose anyway. If it sparks some insight, it would be cause for great joy. If not, it’s within expectations.

That’s why.

Now, Xianyao City has gathered a large number of True Immortals and Half-Step Immortal Kings. Ordinary cultivators walking on the street might come across a renowned Half-Step Immortal King.

And these True Immortals and Half-Step Immortal Kings are extremely low-profile in Xianyao City, as after all, they are under the watchful eye of an Immortal King, and no powerful individual dares to disturb the peace.

Entrance of the Martial Temple.

Three figures walked out.

“So many True Immortals…”

“I’ve never seen so many True Immortals in my life…”

Jun Haiqiu and the other junior members of the Jun Family opened their eyes wide, looking towards the profoundly deep auras within Xianyao City.

The Daode Immortal Sect, as one of the three giants of the Xuanwang Domain, only had dozens of True Immortals stationed, but there seemed to be hundreds of thousands of them now in Xianyao City.

And that doesn’t include those Half-Step Immortal Kings.

Moreover, as time passed, more and more True Immortals and Half-Step Immortal Kings kept on arriving.

“In a Great Realm like the Xuanwang Domain, there are typically several hundred True Immortal-level Powerhouses, and Xuanwang Domain is just one of the thousands of Great Realms in Dongyun Tao Province. The Wuji Ancestor, as an Immortal King, has attracted the attention of True Immortals from dozens of surrounding provinces, hundreds of Tao Provinces.”

“Hundreds of thousands of True Immortals? The number of True Immortals arriving next is estimated to exceed a million…”

Jun Nangong said softly.

“A million True Immortals…”

Jun Yunxun swallowed nervously.

“If it weren’t for the Wuji Ancestor, how could we possibly stand here now…” Jun Haiqiu said with emotion.

They had come to visit the Martial Ancestor and had soon met Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan told them to stay at the Martial Temple for a while and would find time to give them some guidance when he was free.

That was why the three of them could come and go from the Martial Temple with such ease.

Such treatment would probably make those Half-Step Immortal King Powerhouses outside jealous.

Being able to freely enter and leave the Martial Temple is equivalent to feeling the breath of the Martial Ancestor up close, which is a great honor for those Half-Step Immortal Kings. Staying in close proximity to an Immortal King is also a huge opportunity for them.

…

Inside the cave dwelling.

Lin Yuan was sitting cross-legged.

“`

Orange-yellow flames burned continuously within his body.

Lin Yuan’s physical body began to collapse, turning to ash that fell away after an unknown amount of time.

In the blink of an eye, “Blood Rebirth” operated, and Lin Yuan’s physical body rapidly recovered, coming back once again.

“I can feel it, I’m almost done completely absorbing the orange-yellow liquid…” Lin Yuan’s eyes were slightly closed as he felt the enhancements to his body and Inner World.

Now, Lin Yuan’s Inner World was 6.5 times larger than that of a normal Eighth Layer Evolver.

Aside from the 3.33 times increase provided by the crimson liquid, the orange-yellow liquid had brought Lin Yuan’s enhancement up to 3.2 times.

This was extremely close to the maximum enhancement limit of the orange-yellow liquid—3.33 times.

“I should be close to encountering the third type of liquid…”

Lin Yuan thought silently.

“However, in the process of absorbing the first two types of liquids, my Divine Skill ‘Blood Rebirth’ has also been exercised and enhanced?”

A smile emerged on Lin Yuan’s face.

As a Physical Body Divine Ability, “Blood Rebirth” could also be strengthened, albeit at an exceedingly slow rate. However, after thousands, even tens of thousands of times of absorbing the liquids from the Mysterious Gourd, causing the collapse and then recovery of his physical body, “Blood Rebirth” was naturally able to be strengthened.

“This is good; it saves me having to go through the process again after I return to the Main World.”

Lin Yuan was in a good mood.

In the Spirit Realm, it took Lin Yuan a full hundred years to fully absorb the orange-yellow liquid.

But with this hundred-year enhancement of the Physical Body Divine Ability “Blood Rebirth,” Lin Yuan would need, at most, only a few days to completely absorb the orange-yellow liquid upon returning to the Main World.

Because Lin Yuan had greatly elevated his comprehension of “Blood Rebirth,” he could withstand the burning of the orange-yellow flames for a longer period, the same being true in the Main World.

…

The Nine Heavens.

The Seventh Layer of Heaven.

The Taiji Primordial Spirit ascended, surveying his surroundings.

“I’ll start with the Seventh Layer of Heaven to see if I can encounter an Immortal King…” After learning that the Power of Creation wielded by the Immortal Kings was equivalent to the Cosmic Force of the Main World,

Lin Yuan was extremely enthusiastic about finding other Immortal King Level powerhouses.

Especially the existence at the level of a Supreme Immortal King, whose Power of Creation could be equivalent to that of a higher Cosmic Force,

Comprehending such a higher Cosmic Force would aid Lin Yuan enormously once he stepped into the Ninth Rank, giving him more than ten times the benefit than from comprehending ordinary Cosmic Forces.

Given the limited time, Lin Yuan naturally focused on comprehending higher Cosmic Forces.

“This Layer of Heaven…”

Lin Yuan released his senses, trying to spread them in all directions as much as possible.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s eyes brightened as he detected the breath of an Immortal King.

Whoosh.

He headed straight towards the Immortal King.

Moments later.

Lin Yuan stopped.

Looking ahead,

he saw a towering, burly figure standing before him, closely observing a spectacle similar to a “black hole” in the distance.

“What’s this?”

Lin Yuan observed the towering figure, who was carrying a huge axe. Merely sitting there, the aura emanating from the axe felt as though it could split open countless worlds.

“Is this the Open Heaven Immortal King? Does he wield the ‘Power of Opening the Heavens’?”

Lin Yuan was slightly shaken. Among the many pieces of information provided by the purple-robed elder, the Open Heaven Immortal King’s destructive power could rank in the top three among the Supreme Immortal Kings of this era, and his Power of Opening the Heavens could nearly cleave apart anything.

“Hmm?”

As if sensing someone’s gaze, the towering figure of the Open Heaven Immortal King glanced at Lin Yuan.

“Open Heaven Immortal King…” Lin Yuan walked up with a smile.

A short while later.

Lin Yuan stored away a strand of the Power of Opening the Heavens and left contentedly.

As a fellow Supreme Immortal King, it was not too difficult to request a strand of the Power of Opening the Heavens for study, as long as he showed goodwill.

Of course, Lin Yuan also offered his Taiji Power in exchange.

Having never appeared in the Spirit Realm before, the Taiji Power piqued the Open Heaven Immortal King’s curiosity, and he agreed readily and promptly.

Just like that.

Lin Yuan’s Taiji Primordial Spirit remained in the Seventh Layer of Heaven, studying the Powers of Creation of many Immortal Kings.

Three hundred years flew by in the blink of an eye.
